formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p68_t2_adaptive_row_many_error (q n : ℕ) (outer : P68FPModel) ... : absolute error ≤ gamma_(q−1) outer term + (1+gamma_(q−1)) summed gamma_n bucket terms
formal_statement.plain_language: The variable-bucket adaptive row product satisfies the source two-stage error composition with classical gamma constants and no input conversion.

informal_proof: Apply each bucket precision’s γ_n inner-product error; apply the γ_(q−1) recursive-summation error to the q rounded bucket totals; combine the two variable-length stages by the triangle inequality.
informal_statement: For one sparse row partitioned into q precision-specific buckets, each n-entry bucket inner product and the q-term high-precision accumulation have absolute error bounded by a gamma_(q−1) outer term plus (1+gamma_(q−1)) times the summed gamma_n bucket terms.

tier_rationale: For arbitrary positive bucket count q and inner length n, L calls distinct substantial dotProduct_backward_error and recursiveSum_backward_error results. N reconstructs both variable-length numerical analyses locally. The target is the one-row, q-bucket specialization of source equations (3.5)–(3.6), using the source-discussed classical gamma constants and already-represented inputs to omit conversion errors. No fixed two-term outer sum shortcut remains.
